_metadata.description: Single-source story contracts for preview, generated controls, fixtures, and catalog tests.

requirements.title: Every catalog version owns one validated story contract
requirements.description: Every eligible component and hook version contains exactly one schemaVersioned story.json. It owns one public args or hook-input schema and named stories provide only valid values, fixtures, interactions, and expectations.

requirements.title: Generated controls validate one public input boundary
requirements.description: The workbench renders controls from the asset-level schema, validates edits before rendering, retains the last valid specimen on failure, and does not use raw JSON as its default editing path.

requirements.title: State and external dependencies remain explicit and safe
requirements.description: Internal state is reached through real interactions or public controlled/default APIs. External state uses only declared provider or adapter fixtures. Contracts cannot execute setup, imports, functions, arbitrary hook mutation, storage writes, or network side effects.

requirements.title: The cutover is complete and legacy preview metadata is rejected
requirements.description: The deterministic conformance report covers every entry in library/story-migration-inventory.json and fails missing story.json, legacy examples.json, controls, setup, invalid values, or undeclared fixtures.
